summary: App State beat JMU 34-31 in overtime on London’s field goal. Singleton played after being listed questionable, and Phares’s interception created a late lead. Georgia Southern is next Saturday evening.

items.headline: London’s 40-yard overtime field goal beats JMU
items.tldr: The 34-31 win was App State’s second straight comeback victory. The next trip is to Georgia Southern Saturday at 6:30 p.m. ET on ESPN+.

items.headline: Singleton plays and throws for 271 yards against JMU
items.tldr: The quarterback appeared after the earlier questionable designation. Keep his completed outing separate from any assumption about the next availability report.

items.headline: Phares’s interception sets up the go-ahead touchdown
items.tldr: Hasselbeck found Douglas for the score after the takeaway. Watch the coverage discipline that lets the defense turn a passing read into an extra possession.

items.headline: Wisloski’s 70-yard score exposes a coverage cost
items.tldr: JMU’s long touchdown was a reminder to carry the route and finish the first tackle. Keep that correction visible while reviewing the overtime win.

items.headline: App State forces four straight early three-and-outs
items.tldr: JMU Sports News details the Dukes’ stalled possessions after their opening score. Watch whether App State can pair another defensive stretch with more sustained offense.

lead.headline: Make the stop survive the next play.
lead.body: Carry the receiver through the break and finish the tackle before the pursuit separates. On offense, protect the exchange and give the quarterback a receiving answer that can sustain a drive.

matchup.thesis: Keep pressure, coverage and possession connected
matchup.question: What should fans watch in the next game?
matchup.answer: Close the pocket without abandoning the deeper route. When the offense gets another chance, take the clean first gain before asking a late comeback to supply the whole scoring plan.
